memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Vitamin D deficiency
  - Status: newly diagnosed, serum 25‑OH Vit D 12 ng/mL (low)
  - Plan: start cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then 1000 IU OD; check calcium & phosphate.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: serum B12 180 pg/mL (low), MCV 92 fL, Hb 13.2 g/dL
  - Plan: methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.
- Migraine prophylaxis
  - Status: episodic migraine 4‑5 days/month, on propranolol 40 mg OD
  - Plan: continue propranolol, add sumatriptan 50 mg SOS for acute attacks; consider topiramate if needed.
- Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cut‑off for men) – advise reduced‑carb diet.
- Diet advice: Breakfast – multigrain toast + egg white; Lunch – mixed vegetable salad + lean protein; Dinner – lentil soup + steamed veg.
- Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-07-05).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Hi Doctor, I’ve had 3 migraine episodes in the past two weeks, each lasting about 6 hours. Sumatriptan helped but I felt mild drowsiness. No new triggers noticed. Please advise if we need to adjust preventive meds.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Vitamin D deficiency
  - Status: after 8 weeks loading, 25‑OH Vit D 28 ng/mL (suboptimal)
  - Plan: switch to cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD; recheck in 3 months.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency
  - Status: B12 420 pg/mL (normal), MCV 89 fL
  - Plan: continue methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD.
- Migraine
  - Status: frequency down to 2 days/month on propranolol 40 mg OD
  - Plan: maintain propranolol, keep sumatriptan SOS; consider taper if sustained.
- Weight 77 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – oats + nuts; Lunch – quinoa + grilled chicken + veg; Dinner – fish + stir‑fried greens.
- Due: HbA1c repeat in 3 months (2025-10-10).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Neurological examination: no focal deficits, normal gait, mild tenderness over temporalis bilaterally. No signs of increased intracranial pressure. CT head (performed earlier) was normal. No indication for further imaging at present.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Doctor, I’ve noticed a mild throbbing headache on the left side after long hours at the desk. It lasts about 2 hours and responds to naproxen. No visual aura. Should I try topiramate for prevention?

memories.author: D04
memories.text:

- Vitamin B12 deficiency

- Migraine
  - Status: still 2‑3 days/month, patient reports left‑sided throbbing after work
  - Plan: add topiramate 25 mg HS, titrate to 50 mg HS if tolerated; keep propranolol 40 mg OD.
- Weight 76 kg, waist 88 cm (<90 cm).
